1\. Concurrent adds silently lose tasks 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
_cmd_add loads, modifies and saves the list without coordinating with another process performing
the same sequence. When two commands read the same state before either saves, both announce the same
ID and the later replacement discards one item.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Concurrent add commands can read the same next ID and overwrite one another's changes. ## Fix Focus Areas - todo/cli.py[38-47] - todo/store.py[69-92] ## Recommended Fix Acquire an inter-process lock associated with the list before loading it, and hold that lock through ID allocation and the completed save.
